title: Private Garden Suite - 2BR -10 Min. to Airport
description:
Welcome to the Private Garden Suite. A comfortable 2BR/1BA centrally located between downtown Nashville and the Airport in a quiet neighborhood. Whether you are visiting with family, friends or by yourself this space offers the perfect home base to explore the city while still enjoying a calm neighborhood setting. 

Located on the garden level of our home with it's own private entrance, the suite is designed to feel like your own home away from home.

The space
We live in the upstairs of the house and there is another apartment downstairs next to this guest suite. The spaces are not shared but you will probably see us coming and going and may see guests staying in the other apartment. You have your own patio area that is not shared. The laundry room is located between the two downstairs apartments and is a shared space. The doors lock from the inside of each apartment so there is no access between the spaces when you lock the door behind you after using the washer and dryer.

Guest access
You will have full access to your guest suite, parking space, patio area, and your own private bathroom. The laundry and backyard where the firepit is located is a shared space.

Other things to note
The heat and air are shared between the two apartments and the thermostat is located in the your unit. We will try to accommodate whatever setting you would like !  Thank you for understanding.
